analysis.executiveSummary: Big Balder Brand proposes trading Chris Godwin Jr., A.J. Brown, Chuba Hubbard, and a 2028 2nd-round pick to Mile High Royal Lions for Garrett Wilson and Jonah Coleman. This transaction directly fulfills Big Balder Brand's Retool objective by acquiring 26-year-old elite receiver Garrett Wilson (91.4 D-AVI) to pair with Nico Collins (94.3 D-AVI), while adding 23-year-old backfield asset Jonah Coleman (80.5 D-AVI). Although Big Balder Brand surrenders substantial cumulative dynasty asset value (282.5 D-AVI sent vs. 171.9 D-AVI received), inserting Garrett Wilson into the starting lineup creates a positive FLEX cascade: DeVonta Smith (73.4 C-AVI) and Rashee Rice (59.4 C-AVI) move down into FLEX slots, which fully offsets the starting RB2 transition from Chuba Hubbard (72.9 C-AVI) to Jonah Coleman (55.4 C-AVI) or Omarion Hampton (53.9 C-AVI). For Mile High Royal Lions, acquiring workhorse RB Chuba Hubbard delivers an immediate +17.5 C-AVI upgrade at RB2 over Coleman to support its Increase Playoff Odds push, while adding A.J. Brown (who logged limited practice in Germany ahead of Week 10 and offers elite WR1 upside post-return), Chris Godwin Jr., and draft liquidity. AVI recommends accepting the trade as constructed.
